note: Retrieval eval for .opencode/bin/knowledge.js (BM25 lexical engine). The fixture is self-contained: `entries` is the corpus and `cases` are labelled queries. `expected_id` (or `expected_title`) must be recovered from natural-language phrasing. baseline = trivial substring match of query tokens against the entry title. Thresholds: top1 - baseline_top1 >= 20 pts and top3 >= 80%.

entries.title: Normalize text before lexical scoring
entries.body: The engine folds accents with NFKD, splits camelCase and kebab-case, removes English and Spanish stopwords, and singularizes plurals. Diacritics never block a match because both sides share the same normalizer.

entries.title: CRLF shadowed the final metadata key
entries.body: On a Windows checkout a trailing carriage return can hide the last YAML field when parsing markdown frontmatter. Normalize CRLF to LF first so the description is not silently dropped.

entries.title: Content pin went stale after an edit
entries.body: Every time you touch a skill file its sha256 pin changes. Re-run the integrity checker with the fix flag to regenerate the lock manifest.

entries.title: Auto-managed numbers block
entries.body: The counts section between the marker comments is regenerated by a script. Never edit those numbers by hand; run the update command and commit the result.

entries.title: Standard library only
entries.body: The pack must not add an npm package from the registry. Pulling a dependency breaks the offline guarantee and the installer test.

entries.title: Heuristics live in the user config tree
entries.body: Global instincts are stored under a dot folder resolved from the home directory helper, so the same path works on Windows and Linux and survives across every repository.

entries.title: Regression checks are JSON data
entries.body: Invariant cases live in files under the evals folder and the runner interprets their kind. Add a new check by editing data, not by writing code.

entries.title: Sequential scan on a large relation
entries.body: When a select on a big table grows slow, inspect the explain analyze plan. A sequential scan usually means a missing index on the filter or join column.

entries.title: Cold miss storm on the shared store
entries.body: Many workers can miss the same key at once and hammer the database. Use a short lock or stale-while-revalidate to smooth the stampede after a restart.

entries.title: Bloated artifact shipped compilers
entries.body: A single stage build ships compilers and dev dependencies into the final image. Use a multi stage build and copy only the production node_modules to shrink it.

entries.title: Leftover rows made runs unreliable
entries.body: Tests that reuse one database interfere through orphan rows. Wrap each test in a transaction and roll back, or give every worker its own schema to isolate state.

entries.title: Verify the signature on the raw payload
entries.body: Always check the signature header against the raw request body using the webhook secret. Parsing the JSON first changes the bytes and breaks the check.

entries.title: Retries must not charge twice
entries.body: A payment endpoint should accept an idempotency key so a retried request does not double charge the customer. Persist the key with the result.

entries.title: Pod killed by the memory ceiling
entries.body: An evicted pod usually hit its memory limit. Raise the limit or fix the leak, and set requests close to the real usage so scheduling stays honest.

entries.title: Effect loop from an unstable value
entries.body: An effect that depends on an object recreated every render loops forever. Memoize the value or move it inside the hook so the dependency stays stable.

entries.title: Off by one day in stored dates
entries.body: Store timestamps in UTC and convert only at the edges. Mixing local time zones produces calendar errors that look random across regions.

entries.title: Workspace task graph caching
entries.body: Turborepo skips unchanged packages using content hashing. Declare inputs and outputs correctly or the cache returns stale artifacts and hides a broken build.

entries.title: At least once means deduplicate
entries.body: A broker delivers a message more than once, so a consumer can see the same event twice. Deduplicate by an identity key before any side effect.

entries.title: Stale toggles hide dead branches
entries.body: Old flags accumulate and keep unreachable code alive. Track an owner and an expiry date for every toggle and remove it after full rollout.

entries.title: Low vision fails the ratio check
entries.body: A colored button that fails the contrast ratio is unreadable for low vision users. Use semantic tokens for color and check with an automated contrast tool.

entries.title: Stitch logs across service boundaries
entries.body: Propagate a trace context header so log lines from different services can be joined into one timeline during an incident.

entries.title: Small branches conflict less
entries.body: A branch that diverges for weeks conflicts heavily. Rebase onto trunk often and keep the change small to avoid painful merges.
